slice: Attribute sampled hardware branch misprediction records

decision.finding: Of 2216 recorded hot-loop misprediction entries, 1768 (79.78%) originate at the no-candidate-tag branch, and 154 (6.95%) at the full-key equality branch. This distinguishes actual branch addresses from the earlier sampled event IP hotspot.
decision.scope: Finite, potentially overlapping branch histories sampled on branch misses. These are not unique retired branch counts, population misprediction rates, or evidence that the optional type-inference patch increases execution cost.

method.question: Which actual branch addresses carry hardware misprediction flags in sampled branch histories from the earlier executable without equality counters?
method.implementation: Reuse the byte-identical AA executable from the preceding branch-sampling study. Add only perf record --branch-filter any,u,save_type. Keep branch-misses:u, period 10007, 64 mmap pages, CLOCK_MONOTONIC and the existing phase gates.
method.design: Exactly four groups and 16 fresh processes with the unchanged native seed inputs 0 and 4, preparation rotations, execution orders, 32 warmups and 261 prepared plans. All state, release-order and address settings stay as in the prior branch-sampling collection.
method.validation: Run the existing eight-process profiling smoke validation first. Decode the branch stacks from those same files, checking sample identity against the ordinary decoder, CPU/PID/time bounds, stack depth, legal flags, and at least one decoded hardware misprediction. Freeze the successful decoder before collection. Do not recollect successful smoke data for decoder-only changes.
method.analysis: Retain all samples and every branch entry. Summarize recorded histories by branch source offset, target, prediction flag and speculation class, with the previous exact ELF symbol range as reference. Count recorded history entries, not unique retired branches; histories can overlap and the sample trigger is biased toward misses. No exact population misprediction rate or timing effect is estimated.
method.stopping_rule: One fixed four-group collection only after capability and smoke checks pass. Retain every failed attempt and correction. No discarded runs, alternative inputs or outcome-based extension. No other work during profiling. Shared inputs and all global settings remain unchanged.
limits: Branch histories have finite depth and can overlap between samples. They do not record every branch of every lookup.
The sampled event IP can still skid; attribution uses the branch-history source/target and prediction flags instead.
Speculative wrong-path entries are retained and reported separately.
The binary retains earlier cold diagnostics and controlled addresses; it is not the original release executable. The optional type-inference patch remains unadopted.

mispredicted_entries.branch_meaning: No candidate hash tags in the current group
Continue the inner Boolean packing loop
Continue the outer Boolean packing loop
Empty tag terminates an unsuccessful lookup
Return from the lookup and packing function

source_audit.kernel_source_scope: Upstream version reference, not an assertion that all Fedora patches are identical. The code maps hardware mispredict bits to perf branch flags and adjusts branch-source addresses for instruction fusion.
source_audit.branch_format: FROM/TO/EVENT/INTX/ABORT/CYCLES/TYPE/SPEC; M and P mean mispredicted and predicted, N is not-taken, and - is unavailable.

reproduction.setup: Reuse the exact referenced executable and prior scripts. Add perf --branch-filter any,u,save_type. Freeze the branch decoder after the existing smoke data passes. Keep every prediction and speculation flag and compare sample identities to the ordinary decoder. The archive retains raw perf bytes, raw branch text, all captures, frozen scripts, disassembly and source identities.
